fields.meta_title: Donation Receipt Form With Numbered Receipts | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a donation receipt form that numbers each receipt, describes in-kind gifts, and saves every gift in a database you own.
fields.h1: Build a Donation Receipt Form That Writes the Receipt for You
fields.hero_description: Build a donation receipt form that turns each logged gift into a numbered receipt, saved in a database you own.
fields.features_heading: Every Receipt, Filled From the Gift Record
fields.features_subheading: A paper receipt book leaves staff copying names and amounts by hand. Here, the app fills each receipt from the gift staff logged.
fields.feature_1:
Describe the receipt, get the form behind it

Describe the receipt your office sends and the gifts it covers. Emergent builds the entry form, the receipt layout, and the donor tables, then changes them when you prompt again.
fields.feature_2:
Fields that change with the kind of gift

Pick cash or check and the form asks for the amount and the date received. Pick donated goods and it asks for a description of each item instead, with no box for a dollar value.
fields.feature_3:
Receipt numbers that count up by one

Each saved gift takes the next number in the year's series, such as 2026-0418. The treasurer can match any receipt to its gift record and see at a glance if a number is missing.
fields.feature_4:
Online gifts receipted with no typing

Connect the Stripe account your online gifts run through. Each completed payment fills a receipt record with the donor, amount, and date, like a gift logged at the front desk.
fields.feature_5:
A heads-up when a receipt needs a person

Each goods receipt waits for a staff check, and Slack tells your development channel a receipt is waiting, with a link to the record. Names and amounts stay in the database.
fields.feature_6:
Your receipt app, in your GitHub repository

On paid plans, export the full codebase to your GitHub repository and host the receipt app beside your donor system. The receipt layout and the numbering rules move with the code.

fields.usecase_heading: Four Gifts, Four Kinds of Receipt
fields.tab_content_1:
By noon, Imelda's $400 check has its receipt

Imelda Strathcove's $400 check to Tamarack Valley Food Bank becomes receipt 2026-0418. The IRS says the written acknowledgment for a gift of $250 or more must contain the organization's name and the cash amount. Her emailed receipt has both, plus a line stating that no goods or services were provided.
fields.tab_content_2:
From the loading dock, a receipt with no dollar value

Gareth Ovington drops off a sofa and 2 bookcases at Old Mill Reuse Center's dock, and the dock lead logs them on a tablet. The IRS lists a description, but not the value, of a non-cash contribution among the contents of a written acknowledgment. His receipt describes each piece and its condition, with no dollar figure.
fields.tab_content_3:
When a $150 gala seat includes a $60 dinner

Quillmarsh Youth Orchestra sells gala seats at $150, each with a dinner it values at $60. The IRS requires a disclosure statement when a donor's quid pro quo payment is more than $75, giving a good faith estimate of what the donor received. Every gala receipt states the $60 estimate beside the price paid.
fields.tab_content_4:
In January, one statement for 12 gifts of $30

Rosamund Vesterholm gives Kestwood Animal Shelter $30 a month by card. In early January, the app gathers her 12 gifts from the year before into one statement, each with its date and amount, $360 in all. She gets it by email, and the shelter's copy stays on her donor record for the day she asks for it again.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Donation Receipt Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create a donation receipt form that gives each kind of gift the right receipt, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 List every way gifts reach you
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Ask each gift type only what it needs
fields.howto_step_1_des: List the ways gifts arrive today: checks at the front desk, card payments online, furniture at the dock, gala tickets. Each one becomes a gift type on the form, with its own questions and its own receipt layout.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Enter the legal name your receipts carry and the address donors know. Then write the line a receipt uses when the donor got nothing back, in the words your board or your accountant has approved.
fields.howto_step_3_des: A check needs its amount and the day it came in. Donated goods need a description of each item and its condition. Gala tickets need the price paid and your estimate of what the guest received.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Start the series at the number your paper receipt book would have used next, so the records run on without a break. Put the year in front, and the count starts again at 0001 each January.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Connect the payment account your website gifts go through, so each completed payment creates a gift record. Run one small gift through it first and check that the name, amount, and date match the payment.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Pick the receipts a staff member reads before they go out, such as goods a volunteer described at the dock. Those wait in a review list. Every other receipt is sent as soon as the gift is saved.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Test with one gift of each type
fields.howto_step_7_des: Log a test gift for each type and read every receipt the way a donor would. Check the number series, the goods descriptions, and the gala estimate, then delete the test records before the first real gift.

faq_plan.q: What is a donation receipt form?
faq_plan.a: A donation receipt form is where a nonprofit records a gift as it arrives, and that record becomes the donor's receipt. For gifts of $250 or more, the IRS lists what the written acknowledgment must contain. The form asks for those details up front.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a donation receipt form?
faq_plan.a: Describe your gift types and the receipt you send today in Emergent's AI form builder. Emergent writes the staff form, the receipt, and the records behind both from that prompt, and changes any of them when you prompt again. The free tier covers building and publishing.

faq_plan.q: What should a donation receipt form collect?
faq_plan.a: Collect what the receipt has to state and what you need to send it. The IRS list for a written acknowledgment includes a description and good faith estimate of the value of goods or services, if any, given in return. Ask whether the donor received anything, then take the donor's name, email, and the date the gift came in.

faq_plan.q: Can a donation receipt form send the receipt automatically after an online gift?
faq_plan.a: Yes, once the receipt form is connected to the account the online gift runs through. Every finished payment adds a gift record, and the receipt is written from it. Gifts from a paypal donation form work the same way: the payment arrives, the record is saved, and the donor gets a numbered receipt.

faq_plan.q: When does a donation receipt form need to show the gala dinner estimate?
faq_plan.a: On the receipt, unless the estimate already went out with the invitation. The IRS says the charity must furnish the statement in connection with either the solicitation or the receipt of the quid pro quo contribution. Printing it on the invitation and on the receipt covers both moments.

faq_plan.q: Can donors fill out a donation receipt form themselves at a drop-off?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Put a donor-facing version on a tablet by the door, asking one question per screen: name, email, then what they brought. Staff check the description before the receipt is sent. Emergent can build that one-question-per-screen flow from the same prompt as the staff version.

faq_plan.q: How do I resend a receipt from a donation receipt form?
faq_plan.a: Look the donor up and resend the receipt from their record. Every receipt is saved with its number and date, whether the gift came through the donation form on your website or the front desk. With Emergent, those records live in a database you own, and old receipts stay within reach.

faq_plan.q: How do I correct an amount on a donation receipt form after it is sent?
faq_plan.a: Void the receipt and issue a new one with the next number in the series. Keep the voided receipt on the gift record, marked void with the reason. The number series then has no gap. Then email the donor the corrected receipt with a short note.

faq_plan.q: Can a donation receipt form send gifts to accounting software?
faq_plan.a: The app can post each gift to your accounting software through its API as the gift is saved, with the amount, the date, and the fund. Your bookkeeper then matches receipts to deposits without retyping either one. Emergent connects the form to any accounting tool that has an API.

faq_plan.q: Should a donation receipt form send monthly donors a receipt for every gift?
faq_plan.a: Either works: a receipt for each gift, or one statement in January that lists the year. Pick one and tell donors which to expect. If monthly gifts come in through a stripe donation form, each charge creates its own gift record. The January statement is built from those rows.

plan.angle: The top 10 for donation receipt form are printable PDF and Word templates (eForms, Invoice Simple, a Goodwill PDF) and nonprofit blog guides (Bloomerang, Neon One, Keela, CallHub) that explain what a receipt holds but leave staff to type each one. This page shows the receipt form as a working app: a staff or donor entry form whose fields change with the gift type, a numbered receipt with the contents the IRS lists for gifts of $250 or more, the good faith estimate a gala ticket needs, and a January statement per donor, every receipt saved in a database the nonprofit owns.

intent.evidence: Searchers want what a receipt must say and a form that produces it: FAQ 3 'What should a donation receipt form collect?' and tabs 1-3 quote the IRS acknowledgment contents (org name, cash amount, goods description with no value, no-goods statement, quid pro quo estimate); 7-step how-to; four gift types.

specificity.evidence: Receipt 2026-0418, a $400 check at Tamarack Valley Food Bank, a sofa and 2 bookcases at the dock, $150 gala seat with a $60 dinner, 12 x $30 = $360 statement; table uses form variant.

openers.evidence: Feature bodies open on verbs or full sentences: 'Describe the receipt your office sends', 'Pick cash or check and the form asks', 'Connect the Stripe account'.

craft.evidence: Two ', so' endings (steps 4, 5) under the limit; noted only.

voice.evidence: Plain product verbs, concrete detail ('Start the series at the number your paper receipt book would have used next'); no AI tells found.

truth.evidence: IRS statements match their quoted irs.gov spans with no widening and no tax-deductibility claim; but the review step contradicts itself across fields: feature_5 'Gifts of goods and gala tickets post a Slack message ... saying a receipt is waiting' and howto_step_6 'Those wait in a review list' vs tab image 2 'Goods receipt sent' + 'Save and send receipt', mockup donatedGoods 'Email the donor a receipt that lists the items, and post a Slack message', tab image 3 '5 gala receipts sent' and mockup galaTickets 'When a guest buys a seat, email a receipt'.

distinct.evidence: Receipting after the gift (numbering, in-kind descriptions, quid pro quo estimate, year-end statement); does not headline donation request, paypal or stripe donation, which are linked as FAQ anchors only.

faq.evidence: 10 on-topic questions, no brand or file-format ask, hub link in item 2, sibling links 'paypal donation form' and 'stripe donation form', answers answer first, FAQ 5 matches the IRS solicitation-or-receipt span.

images.evidence: Numbers agree with copy ($400 vs $250 rule, $150/$60 vs $75, 12 x $30 = $360 with 4 x $90), one hero per panel, Slack line carries no names or amounts; the sent-vs-waiting status conflict is recorded under truth.

findings.quote: Gifts of goods and gala tickets post a Slack message to your development channel saying a receipt is waiting, with a link to the record.
findings.issue: The page tells two incompatible stories about when goods and gala receipts go out. feature_5 says goods and gala-ticket receipts wait for a person (title 'A heads-up when a receipt needs a person'), and howto_step_6 says goods receipts 'wait in a review list' while 'Every other receipt is sent as soon as the gift is saved' (FAQ 6 also: 'Staff check the description before the receipt is sent'). Every other field shows those receipts sent at once: tab image 2 hero 'Goods receipt sent' with button 'Save and send receipt' and, in the same card, 'Slack: a receipt is waiting, with a link' (sent and waiting at once); mockup donatedGoods 'Email the donor a receipt that lists the items, and post a Slack message to our team'; tab image 3 mini '5 gala receipts sent' and every row 'Sent'; mockup galaTickets 'When a guest buys a seat, email a receipt'; tab_content_3 'Every gala receipt states the $60 estimate beside the price paid.'
findings.fix: Pick one flow and apply it in every field. Simplest: feature_5 covers only receipts held for review (e.g. goods a volunteer described at the dock), drop gala tickets from it, and make the Slack text say a goods receipt is waiting for review. Then either redraw tab 2 as held for review (hero 'Goods receipt waiting for review', button 'Save for review', Slack line kept; mockup donatedGoods says the receipt waits for a staff check before it is emailed), or keep tab 2 as sent and remove the Slack 'waiting' line from image and mockup. Leave tab 3 gala receipts sent on purchase.
